status: constructed fictional language, anchored to a real script. not a decipherment of anything.
what_this_is: Three words in a made-up language, written in a real and real Unicode-encoded script. The script is outside the fiction and did not come from it: it was excavated, published, encoded, and can be checked without opening this page. The words are ours. Anyone can verify the letters and nobody can verify the words, which is the honest shape of the thing.

script.name: Ugaritic
script.kind: consonantal alphabet (abjad). vowels are not normally written.
script.attested: tablets from Ras Shamra (Ugarit), on the Syrian coast, c. 15th–12th century BCE
script.decipherment: deciphered in 1930–31 by Hans Bauer, Édouard Dhorme and Charles Virolleaud
script.fonts_needed: almost none ship by default, which is why this page embeds one
script.note: Ugaritic is not related to Cybertronian, Iacon, or any Transformers canon. The name 'Iaconian' on the card is the joke; the letters are the grounding.

grammar.syllable: one consonant letter, optionally followed by WO or YOD as a glide
grammar.vowels: unwritten. the romanisation below is our reading, not a property of the text.
grammar.words: one or more syllables run together; the script also has a word divider (U+1039F)
grammar.anything_else: deliberately nothing. three words, no morphology, no syntax beyond word order.

lexicon.gloss: the hold. that which is kept fixed and does not move.
lexicon.why_these_letters: the token is the letter whose Unicode name is TO; the word and the letter are the same object.

lexicon.gloss: a path that has been walked before. a line already crossed.
lexicon.why_these_letters: QOPA plus the glide WO, the only glide the grammar allows here.

lexicon.gloss: to carry a thing back to the place it was found.
lexicon.why_these_letters: it opens and closes on the same letter, because the word means returning.

sentence.reading: The hold, the walked path, carry it back.
sentence.cipher_key: none. there is no key, and no hidden message underneath.

anchors.in_fiction: the letter that is also the word for a hold
anchors.checkable_by: UnicodeData.txt, or any font that shows the block

anchors.in_fiction: opens the word for a path already walked
the letter the returning word opens and closes on

not Ugaritic: these are not Ugaritic words, in any attestation. the letters are Ugaritic, the words are not
no native speakers, no community, no authority. it is three words made today
